description: Mapped orphan candidates grouped by structural review flags, with source availability, incompleteness and freshness. Deletion safety is not established; unmapped calls may hide use. Budgeted: top 20 per tier by span (totals stay true; full:true for all mapped candidates).

all.description: Include non-product roles (tests/fixtures/bench/generated) in the ranking; default is product scope with a counted exclusion

full.description: Return the unabridged result (disables the default budget). Large on big repos.

graph.description: Path to graph.json. OPTIONAL — defaults to CODEWEB_WS or the nearest .codeweb/graph.json above cwd

limit.description: Max items to return (each tool has a sensible default; full:true disables)

name: codeweb_deadcode
